acceptance_criteria.statement: AC1 Secret versions are immutable and auditable.
AC2 Runtime secret access records service/environment operation context.
AC3 Desired-state payloads reference secrets without plaintext.

rollout_gates.gate: Secret audit writes succeed before rollout to runtime apply paths.
Desired-state JSON scans contain only REDACTED(...) placeholders for secret refs.

rollback_criteria.criterion: Block runtime apply for affected secret scopes.
Revert to previous secret version by policy after audit verification.
